info.name: R2 SaaS Base API
info.description:
Postman collection generated from `api/Presentation/Http/Routes/web.php`.

**Auth**
- `x-token` — API credential (env `X_TOKEN`), required by GlobalApiMiddleware
- `x-user-token` — user session token (`user.token` from login/register), required by GlobalApiAuthMiddleware
- Admin routes also require an authenticated user whose `role` contains `admin`

**Recent routes**
- `GET /v2/snappy-orders/{orderId}` — get order by id
- `POST /v2/snappy-orders/{orderId}/unassign-from-batch` — admin clear order batch
- `GET /v2/logs/migrate` — migrate logs table
- `GET /v2/logs` — admin list logs (`type`, `search`, `id`)

Set collection variables `baseUrl`, `xToken`, and `xUserToken` after login.

GET /v2/auth/me

Runs `WalletFeedbackMiddleware` first: verifies pending online top-ups via Paystack, approves/rejects them, and writes `wallet_feedback` rows to `GET /v2/logs`.

query.description: Matches name, email, phone, or role (LIKE)

request.description:
GET /v2/auth/users

Admin only (`UserController::fetch` → `fetchUsersAsAdmin`).

Success shape:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "users": [/* UserEntity[] */],
    "count": 0,
    "message": "Users fetched successfully"
  }
}
```

Optional query filters: `search`, `email`.
On success, sets `userId` from the first returned user.

item.name: Wallet
item.description:
Requires `x-token` + `x-user-token`.

These wallet routes run `WalletFeedbackMiddleware` before the controller: pending online top-ups are verified with Paystack; results are logged (`title: wallet_feedback`) and available via admin `GET /v2/logs`.

request.description:
Creates a pending online top-up and returns a Paystack `payment_url` on the wallet.

Request JSON: `{ "amount": 100 }`

Success shape:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "wallet": {
      "id": 5,
      "user_id": 31,
      "reference": "TOPUP-…",
      "type": "online",
      "amount": 100,
      "balance": 0,
      "description": "Top up online",
      "payment_url": "https://checkout.paystack.com/…",
      "status": "pending",
      "created_at": "2026-08-09 03:43:35"
    },
    "message": "Top up online successful"
  }
}
```

Open `data.wallet.payment_url` to complete payment. Balance stays `0` / status `pending` until Paystack confirms.

item.name: Platform Config
item.description:
Requires `x-token` + `x-user-token`.

Rows are key/value settings (`setting_key`, `setting_value`). Update body uses `setting_name` + `setting_value` (stored uppercase as `setting_key`).

request.description:
POST /v2/platform-configs/update

Body: `{ "setting_name": "SERVICE_CHARGE", "setting_value": "100" }`

Creates the key if missing, otherwise updates `setting_value`.

DELETE /v2/platform-configs/{{platformConfigId}}/delete

Deletes by row `id` from List Platform Configs.

exec: var batch = json.data && json.data.batch ? json.data.batch : (json.batch || null);

request.description: Saves `batch.id` → `batchId` on success.

item.name: Threads
item.description:
Order message threads. Requires `x-token` + `x-user-token`. `sender_id` is taken from the authenticated user.

On create: creates an in-app notification for the order owner. If the sender is not the order owner, also emails the customer via ThreadNotificationService.

exec: var thread = json.data && json.data.thread ? json.data.thread : (json.thread || null);

request.description:
POST /v2/threads

Body (form-data): `order_id`, `message`, optional `attachment_url` file.
`sender_id` = authenticated user.

Side effects: in-app notification to order owner; email to customer when sender ≠ order owner.
Saves `thread.id` → `threadId` on success.

GET /v2/threads/{order_id}

Returns all thread messages for the order (ordered by `created_at` ASC) plus `count`.

exec: var order = json.data && json.data.order ? json.data.order : (json.order || null);

request.description: Saves `order.id` → `orderId` on success. Attach screenshot files in form-data.

Admin only. Body JSON: `{ "status": "..." }`.

Valid statuses (`SnappyOrderRepositoryInterface::ALLOWED_STATUSES`):
- pending
- paid
- placed
- shipped-to-facility
- arrived-at-facility
- shipped-to-destination-country
- arrived-at-destination-country
- arrived-at-destination-facility
- ready-for-pickup
- delivered
- cancelled

Rules:
- Cannot change back to `pending`
- `cancelled` only from `pending`
- Setting `ready-for-pickup` generates `pickup_otp_code` and emails the customer

Admin only. `SnappyOrderController::changePrice` → `SnappyOrderService::changePrice`.

Body JSON (either key):
- `{ "price": 55.5 }`
- `{ "total_amount_usd": 55.5 }`

Rules:
- Order status must be `pending`
- Recalculates service charge, shipping, FX, and `grand_total_naira`
- Sets `price_adjustment_sent` = 1 and emails the customer

Success shape:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "order": {},
    "message": "Order price updated successfully"
  }
}
```
Admin only. Assigns a snappy order to an existing batch. Uses `orderId` and `batchId` collection variables.

Admin only. `SnappyOrderController::publishSettings`.

Writes current snappy-order defaults into platform config keys:
- SERVICE_CHARGE
- SHIPPING_COST
- DOLLAR_TO_NAIRA_RATE

Success shape:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "message": "Settings published successfully"
  }
}
```

item.name: Categories
item.description: Requires `x-token` + `x-user-token`. Admin write routes also need an admin role.

request.description:
GET /v2/categories/admin

Admin only. Includes inactive categories.

Admin only. Form-data: `name`, optional `parent_id`, `description`, `slug`, required `image` file.

Upload uses `FileUploadServiceInterface` into `/uploads/categories` (same pattern as snappy order screenshots).
Slug is auto-generated from name when omitted.

Admin only. POST /v2/categories/{{categoryId}}.

Omit `image` to keep the existing image. When provided, uploaded via `FileUploadServiceInterface`.
Admin only. Fails if the category has child categories.

item.name: Products
item.description: Requires `x-token` + `x-user-token`. Admin write routes also need an admin role.

request.description:
GET /v2/products/admin

Admin only. Includes inactive products.

GET /v2/products/merchant

Calls `ProductService::fetchForMerchant` for the authenticated user (`user_id` = auth user).

Includes inactive products owned by the merchant.

GET /v2/products/{{productId}}

Calls `ProductService::findById`.

GET /v2/products/slug/{{productSlug}}

Calls `ProductService::findBySlug`.

GET /v2/products/uuid/{{productUuid}}

Calls `ProductService::findByUuid`.

Admin only. Form-data: `name`, `description`, `price`, `old_price`, `stock_qty`, `category_id`, optional `slug`, optional `user_id` (defaults to auth user), required `image_1`, optional `image_2`…`image_7`.

Uploads via `FileUploadServiceInterface` into `/uploads/products`. `image` is set from `image_1`. UUID is generated server-side. New products start with `active=0`.

Admin only. POST /v2/products/{{productId}}.

Form-data includes `active` (0 or 1). Omit any `image_*` field to keep that existing image. Uploading `image_1` also updates legacy `image`.
Admin only. Calls `ProductService::remove`.

item.name: User KYCs
item.description:
Requires `x-token` + `x-user-token`. Admin list/approve/reject routes need an admin role.

`approved` values: `-1` pending, `1` approved, `0` rejected.

request.description:
GET /v2/user-kycs/my

Calls `UserKycService::fetchForUser` for the authenticated user.

POST /v2/user-kycs

Creates a pending KYC (`approved=-1`) for the auth user. Optional document uploads via `FileUploadServiceInterface` into `/uploads/user_kycs`.

POST /v2/user-kycs/{{kycId}}

Owner only. Cannot update an approved KYC. Resubmits as pending (`approved=-1`). Omit documents to keep existing files.

GET /v2/user-kycs/pending

Admin only. `fetchForApproval` (`approved=-1`).

GET /v2/user-kycs/approved

Admin only. `fetchApproved` (`approved=1`).

GET /v2/user-kycs/rejected

Admin only. `fetchRejected` (`approved=0`).

POST /v2/user-kycs/{{kycId}}/approve

Admin only. Sets `approved=1`, `approved_by` = auth admin. Sends in-app + email via `UserKycNotificationService`.

POST /v2/user-kycs/{{kycId}}/reject

Admin only. Body: required `reject_reason`. Sets `approved=0`. Sends reject notification.

GET /v2/logs

Admin only. Filters: `type` (`success`|`error`), `search`, `id`.

Common titles include `wallet_feedback` (written by `WalletFeedbackMiddleware` when online top-ups are verified).

Success shape:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "logs": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "title": "wallet_feedback",
        "payload": "{...wallet...}",
        "response": "{\"status\":\"success\"}",
        "type": "success",
        "created_at": "2026-08-09 17:00:00",
        "updated_at": "2026-08-09 17:00:00"
      }
    ],
    "count": 1,
    "message": "Logs fetched successfully"
  }
}
```
